game.label: Your own copy of Pro Evolution Soccer 2013, US disc BLUS31029: its decrypted disc image (.iso), or its folder with PS3_GAME and PS3_DISC.SFB in it (as RPCS3 uses). Other regions don't work yet. Setup also asks for its 01.04 update.

inputs.label: The game's 01.04 update for the US disc BLUS31029, as its .pkg from PlayStation Network
Optional: Data Pack 6 for BLUS31029, as its .pkg or the folder with USRDIR in it

prepare.label: Building the game for your Mac from your disc and its 01.04 update (the first time takes 30 to 60 minutes and about 10 GB; it needs Apple's Command Line Tools, Homebrew's cmake, ninja, sdl2 and python@3.12, and the key file added once in the PES 2013 Launcher window)

settings.label: Window
settings.help: Full screen is macOS's own (its own Space). Borderless covers the screen without changing Spaces.

settings.label: Window size
settings.help: The size the game's window opens at.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: On waits for the screen's refresh: no tearing.

settings.label: Resolution
settings.help: What the game draws at. 720p is the PS3's own; higher is sharper and needs a faster Mac. Experimental.

settings.label: Upscaling
settings.help: How the picture is fitted to the window. MetalFX is Apple's upscaler (macOS 13 or newer).

settings.label: Anti-aliasing
settings.help: Smooths jagged edges, the pitch lines most of all.

settings.label: Texture filtering
settings.help: Keeps the pitch markings and the stands sharp at shallow angles.

settings.label: Console language
settings.help: The language the PS3 tells the game. The game's own Portuguese labels are the default; the first start's setup still asks for the game's language.

settings.label: Show FPS
settings.help: The frame rate and frame times in the window's title.

settings.label: Keep the Mac awake
settings.help: The Mac doesn't go to sleep while the game runs.

actions.label: Saves
actions.help: The saves of the default profile, as the game writes them (BLUS31029...).

actions.label: Option File profiles
actions.help: The Option File profiles made in the PES 2013 Launcher window (its Option File page picks the one Play uses).

actions.label: Logs
actions.help: last.log (the last session), install.log (the last setup) and logs/ with the sessions before.

actions.label: Shader cache
actions.help: Shaders the game has translated, so later matches don't stutter. Clearing only helps if the picture looks wrong after an update.

exit_codes.40: Your copy isn't the one this port reads: it needs your own PES 2013 US disc, BLUS31029, as a decrypted disc image (.iso) or a folder with PS3_GAME and PS3_DISC.SFB, and its 01.04 update (.pkg). Pick them again on the game's page.
exit_codes.41: Your Mac needs something first: Apple's Command Line Tools (their installer opened: finish it), Homebrew's cmake, ninja, sdl2 and python@3.12, or the key file that decrypts the game (never shipped: add it once in the PES 2013 Launcher window, Home > Install the game). Then set the game up again.
exit_codes.42: Couldn't download what the build needs (the toolkit from GitHub or its Python packages). Check the internet connection and set the game up again.
exit_codes.43: Building the game failed. Check there are about 10 GB free, then set it up again: it continues where it stopped. install.log in the logs folder says why.
exit_codes.44: PES 2013 is already running, or another setup of it is. Close it or wait for it, then try again.
exit_codes.45: The game isn't built yet. Set it up again on the game's page (the first time takes 30 to 60 minutes).
exit_codes.46: The PES 2013 launcher couldn't start it. Open the launcher itself to see why.
